title: Recreation, Park, and Tourism Management, B.S. — Commercial Recreation and Tourism Management Option (College of Health and Human Development)
notes: Commercial Recreation and Tourism Management Option, University Park (of four; Outdoor Recreation's 7-course 'pathway course' pool has no titles/codes given, and Professional Golf Management requires a golf handicap of 12 or lower for admission). The entire RPTM department catalog was missing -- added minimal entries in new rptm_catalog.json. Real data gap: 'RPTM 433W' requires 'RPTM 356 and a 3-credit statistics course' per its own bulletin listing, but RPTM 356 doesn't exist anywhere in the catalog or this major's suggested plan -- STAT 200 (or 100) is already an explicit required Semester 3 item in this plan, satisfying the '3-credit statistics course' half. Several RPTM 300/400-level courses list a '5th-semester standing' prereq the schema doesn't model directly, same limitation as ABSM/TURF's semester-standing courses. 'RPTM 495A' (Internship, catalog lists 1-3cr repeatable) is modeled at 12cr to match this plan's own stated credit total for the full-time capstone term. Handbook verification pass: RE-VERIFIED the RPTM 356 question directly against this app's own rptm_catalog.json -- RPTM 356 genuinely does not exist in the current catalog (confirmed, not just absent from this plan), and its own RPTM 433W entry's scraped description literally quotes 'RPTM 356 and a 3-credit course in statistics are prerequisites for this course.' The department's own real, live Supporting Courses page (hhd.psu.edu/rptm/undergraduate/supporting-courses) lists a completely different course, RPTM 456 (Programming in Recreation Services, prereq RPTM 236 and RPTM 120, described on its own scraped page as 'the capstone course in the RPTM major') -- nothing on that page or in the catalog supports the earlier guess that RPTM 456 is a renumbered RPTM 356; withdrawing that guess as unconfirmed rather than repeating it. Since RPTM 356 cannot be resolved to any real current course, only the enforceable, real 'and a 3-credit course in statistics' half of RPTM 433W's prereq was added directly to rptm_catalog.json's own prereq_groups (['STAT 200','STAT 100']) -- previously RPTM 433W had no prereq enforcement in the catalog at all. RPTM 356 itself is left permanently unenforced, a genuine, documented data gap (matching this session's convention of deferring what can't be honestly resolved, e.g. CMPSC's grade-minimum tracking) rather than guessed at again. Wired all 5 generic 'Supporting Course' slots to the department's own real Supporting Course List for this exact option (Commercial Recreation and Tourism Management), filtered to the real list's codes that fall within departments this plan already loads (RPTM/STAT/CMPSC/CAS) -- the page's own full list spans 25+ departments (business, marketing, HR, sociology, etc.) well beyond this plan's own department scope, so (as with HPA's identical situation) a bounded, real subset was used rather than expanding into dozens of unscraped departments. Renamed the stale 'Elective / GEN ED (GQ)' label (Semester 6) to plain 'Elective' -- both GQ (Semester 1) and the statistics requirement (Semester 3, STAT 200/100) are already separately, correctly wired elsewhere in this plan, so that label's own GQ reference was leftover from an earlier, now-corrected draft.
